plan.title: What strangers clock in ten seconds
Your red flag (don't pretend you don't have one)
What you overdo, and what you dodge
How you wreck your own love life
What the group chat says when you're not in it
Friends and work: Yeon has receipts
The lie you keep telling yourself
The compliment you keep swatting away

plan2.title: What strangers clock in ten seconds

gentle.speaker: bom
gentle.text: You asked for gentle-ish. I'll hold your hand. She won't. Breathe.

honest.speaker: yeon
honest.text: Honest, like a good friend. So, the friend who tells you there's spinach in your teeth. Before the date.

savage.speaker: yeon
savage.text: "Don't hold back." You're going to regret typing that. I'm not going to regret anything.

unsaid.speaker: yeon
unsaid.text: You didn't pick a level. So you get my default. Bom is already apologising in advance.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. Your first impression lands harder than you think. You walk in with an opinion of the room and the room can feel it.

Bom: Some people find that magnetic.

Yeon: Others decide in ten seconds you're "a lot" and sit at the other end of the table forever.

Next new-people thing: ask three curious questions before you share one opinion. You'll still make an impression. It'll just include "interested in other humans".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You enter a room like you're about to review it.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. In the first ten seconds, people mostly see you watching them.

Yeon: Which is lovely, and also why half of them leave thinking you didn't like them. You liked them. You were just buffering.

Bom: Your warmth arrives on a delay.

Next time, say one real thing in the first minute. A compliment, a joke, an opinion. Skip the buffering.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your warmth is real. Let it arrive a few minutes earlier.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: confidence, opinions, and a posture like you're about to give a talk nobody booked.

Yeon: You walk in like the room should rearrange itself around you. Half the time, it does. Annoying.

Bom: People assume you're in charge. They feel calmer.

Yeon: They also assume you won't need help. So they never offer. And you never ask.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Gap. You enter a party like it's a board meeting you're chairing.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: People feel safe around you. They know you'll handle it.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You don't have opinions. You have policies.

spring.intro: Spring birthday. That's tree season, so you got a double shot of yourself: taller, louder, surer. In saju terms, Wood ran the month you were born in. In real life, you've never once waited to be picked.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood. So the stubbornness is seasonal AND personal. Great.

summer.intro: You're a tree born in the heat. All that growing goes straight into showing: big plans, big talk, big gestures. Summer burns through a pine fast, so you look unstoppable right up until you suddenly need three days in bed.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give off so much light. Just save a little for yourself.

autumn.intro: Autumn is axe season, and you're the tree. Life started trimming you early: rules, pressure, people with opinions. It made you sharper and more disciplined than other pines. It also made you allergic to being told what to do.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pruned young. Explains the posture. And the attitude.

winter.intro: A winter pine. The cold kept you quiet on the outside while the roots drank everything. You think longer than you let on, and when you finally move, it's because you already decided weeks ago.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You look calm. Underneath, you've been planning since November.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when soil runs the show. For a tree, that means work: you're always building, fixing, providing. Very useful. Very tired. Somebody should ask what you want for once.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rest is not a prize you win. It's allowed.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Amazing in a crisis. Impossible in an argument."

Your coworker: "Gets things done. Also redid my slides without asking."

Your best friend: "The most loyal person I know. Will tell you what to do with your life whether you asked or not."

Yeon: All three love you. All three would like you to ask a question occasionally.

open.title: You've never once been wrong. Ask anyone. Actually, ask you.
open.text:
You're the tall pine. Upright, principled, and absolutely convinced the restaurant you picked is the correct restaurant.

Bom: You're reliable. Everyone knows it.

Yeon: Everyone also has a second group chat where they make decisions before telling you.
open.end: Yeon: Now let's see what strangers clock about you in ten seconds. Spoiler: it's the posture. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Pine? You treat disagreement like a | structural threat. Someone suggests a different film and you defend yours like a load-bearing wall.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: "I'm just being efficient." No. You just hate not being in charge.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: warm, easy, interested in them. People leave a chat with you feeling like the most fascinating person alive.

Yeon: They also leave knowing absolutely nothing about you.

Bom: You make people comfortable. That's rare.

Yeon: You make people comfortable so they won't look too closely. Different skill. Same smile.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Eul. You can make friends with a wall. And then the wall does what you want.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're so easy to love. People relax around you instantly.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: In a group you nod at everyone. At home you disagree with all of them.

spring.intro: Spring birthday for the vine. Everything around you was growing, so you learned to grow toward whatever held still long enough. Charming. Flexible. Absolutely capable of getting your way while people believe they chose it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood vine. You don't push. You wrap. Same result.

summer.intro: A flower in full sun. You bloom in public: the outfit, the story, the laugh across the room. The cost is that you wilt on the inside when nobody's watering you, and you'd rather die than ask.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're so easy to love. You just don't always let anyone try.

autumn.intro: Autumn is cutting season, and you're the soft stem. You grew up reading rooms for danger, learning who's sharp and how to bend before they swing. That's why you're so good with people. It's also why you apologise to furniture.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You flinch at "can we talk" like it's a fire alarm.

winter.intro: A winter flower. Cold outside, so you grew inward: rich head, private feelings, a whole inner world nobody gets the password to. When you trust someone, it's total. Getting there takes a season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your inside is so much warmer than you let people see.

earth.intro: Born in the weeks between seasons, when the soil takes over. For a vine, that means you grow by managing things: schedules, people, plans. You're the reason the group trip happened. Nobody thanked you properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unpaid project manager of every friendship. Since birth.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Never knew what they actually wanted. Including them."

Your coworker: "Everyone's favourite. Somehow always gets their way. No idea how."

Your best friend: "Would follow me into a fire. Would also never tell me if I'd upset them."

Yeon: Three people, one wish: that you'd say what you think the first time.

open.title: You say "I don't mind". You mind. You always mind.
open.text:
You're the climbing flower. Adaptable, charming, impossible to dislike. You read every room and become exactly what it needs.

Bom: That's a gift.

Yeon: That's a shapeshifter with excellent PR. Who even are you on a Tuesday alone?
open.end: Yeon: Next page: the first impression you give, and the one you're hiding behind it.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Flower: you never say no. You just | quietly don't do it and hope nobody notices. People notice.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: that you're laid-back. You're conflict-averse with good hair.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: energy, laughter, a story already in progress. People think "oh, they're fun".

Yeon: Ten minutes later: "they're still talking".

Bom: You make shy people feel included. That's beautiful.

Yeon: You also make quiet people feel like the audience. Ask a question. Then actually wait for the answer.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Byeong. You don't enter a room. You premiere.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You make everyone feel invited. That's a real talent.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You tell a story to one person and somehow six people are listening by the end.

spring.intro: The sun, born in spring. Everything was feeding you: new leaves, longer days, people who wanted your attention. So you grew up assuming warmth is normal. When someone's cold to you, it genuinely confuses you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooms get brighter when you arrive. That is not nothing.

summer.intro: The sun at noon in July. Double fire. You don't enter rooms, you arrive. Generous, loud, impossible to ignore, and secretly a little hurt every time someone doesn't notice you lit the place up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Main character, sequel, director's cut. All you.

autumn.intro: An autumn sun. Lower in the sky, aimed at things: harvest, goals, results. You're warm, but you're also counting. You notice exactly who showed up for you and who just liked the post.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Warm and keeping score. Your sunshine comes with receipts.

winter.intro: A winter sun. Short days, cold air, people who needed you more than they could give back. It made you tough and a little performative: the brightest one in the room, even on the days you're running on fumes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You shine hardest when you're the most tired. I see it.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when Earth runs things. For the sun, that means everything you give turns into something solid: a friend's confidence, a plan that worked, a party you made happen. You're a great investment. Ask what you're getting back.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You fund everyone's glow-up and forget to invoice.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Best first three months of my life. Then I realised I was the audience."

Your coworker: "Lights up every meeting. Also turns every meeting into a TED talk."

Your best friend: "Would give me the shirt off their back. Then post about it."

Yeon: All three adore you. All three want one conversation that isn't a show.

open.title: You checked who watched your story before you checked the weather.
open.text:
You're the sun. Warm, generous, impossible to ignore. Every room gets brighter when you walk in, and you can absolutely tell when it doesn't.

Bom: People love being around you.

Yeon: People love being around you. You love that people love being around you. Slightly more.
open.end: Yeon: Next page, the first impression. You think it's "fun". It's "fun, and slightly exhausting".

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Sun: when you're not the centre, you | go cold. Not mean. Just a little dimmer, on purpose, so someone asks.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: "I don't need validation." You need it like a phone needs a charger.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: quiet, observant, a bit reserved. People wonder if you like them.

Yeon: You're not reserved. You're scanning. Mood, outfit, whether they're lying. Full diagnostic.

Bom: Once you warm up, you're the best company in the room.

Yeon: The "once" is doing a lot. Some people give up before the candle's lit.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Jeong. You remember what someone said to you in 2017. Verbatim. With the tone.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: When you love someone, they feel truly seen. That's rare.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You're not "fine". You're writing a very detailed internal report.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Loved me more deeply than anyone. Also never forgot a single mistake."

Your coworker: "Quiet. Brilliant. Terrifying when annoyed."

Your best friend: "Knows me better than I know me. Takes three weeks to say they're upset."

Yeon: All three love you. All three would like the upset delivered same-day.

open.title: You remember what they said in 2017. Word for word. With the tone.
open.text:
You're the candle. Close, warm, intense. One person, one conversation, the whole night. You notice everything.

Bom: That's why people feel so understood by you.

Yeon: That's also why your grudges have their own climate control.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: what people see first. Hint: it's not the warmth. It's the watching.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Candle: you don't say you're hurt. You | go quiet and wait to see if they notice. It's a test, and they always fail it.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: "I've let it go." You've archived it. Letting go is a different button.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: calm, steady, unreadable. People feel safe and slightly unsure if you're enjoying yourself.

Yeon: You are enjoying yourself. Your face just didn't get the memo.

Bom: You're so dependable. People feel it instantly.

Yeon: Smile with your actual eyes once. It costs nothing and saves a lot of "are they okay?"

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Mu. You have the emotional range of a very supportive boulder.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: People trust you within minutes. You're the safest person they know.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Changing your mind takes you longer than a passport renewal.

spring.intro: A mountain in spring, with trees pushing through it from every side. Life tested you early. That's why you're so steady now, and also why "relax" sounds to you like a trick.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You became the calm one because someone had to.

summer.intro: A summer mountain, warmed all the way through. Solid, generous, the one everyone leans on. You give off safety without trying. People tell you things they've never told anyone, and you never repeat them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: People feel safe with you within five minutes. Rare.

autumn.intro: An autumn mountain, showing its stone. You turn your weight into output: work done, things built, problems quietly solved. You don't talk about feelings much. You show them by fixing the shelf.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Love language: unasked-for repairs. Every time.

winter.intro: A mountain in winter, holding back the river. You manage things: money, plans, other people's chaos. Very good at it. The cost is that you rarely let anything thaw, including you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're not cold. You're frozen on purpose. Different.

earth.intro: A mountain born in Earth's own weeks. Triple solid. You don't move unless you want to, and you almost never want to. Your loyalty is legendary. So is the time it takes you to change your mind.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Persuading you is a geological process.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "The most reliable person I've ever dated. I never once knew what they felt."

Your coworker: "If the building was on fire, I'd follow them out. Also, change is impossible with them."

Your best friend: "Has been there for every bad day. Has said 'I'm fine' through all of theirs."

Yeon: All three would trade some reliability for one sentence with a feeling in it.

open.title: You're not stubborn. You're just correct, very slowly.
open.text:
You're the mountain. Steady, dependable, the one everyone leans on. You don't panic. You don't rush. You don't move.

Bom: You're the calm in every storm.

Yeon: You're the calm in every storm because you refuse to acknowledge the storm exists.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: the first impression. People think "solid". Some of them also think "wall".

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Mountain: you call it patience. It's | avoidance. You wait things out because moving would mean feeling them.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: "I'm just low-maintenance." You're high-maintenance. You just never file the request.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: warm, helpful, a little busy. You've offered someone water, a charger and advice before they sat down.

Yeon: Very kind. Also slightly overwhelming. Let people arrive.

Bom: People feel cared for by you immediately.

Yeon: They also feel like you're managing them. Because, babe, you are.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Gi. You've packed snacks for a trip you're not even going on.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You look after everyone. People feel held around you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You keep a mental list of who owes you a favour. It's laminated.

spring.intro: A garden in spring, with everything sprouting from you at once. You grew up being needed: the friend who listens, the kid who helped. Lovely trait. Exhausting default.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You nourish everybody. Your turn next.

summer.intro: Garden soil in summer, warm and rich. You're nurturing on instinct and practical about it: snacks in the bag, charger for everyone, a plan B nobody asked for. Everyone feels a bit safer near you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You packed plasters for a picnic. Twice.

autumn.intro: A harvest-season garden. Everything you grow, you hand out. Ideas, help, advice, food. The harvest is real, but so is the empty field afterwards, and you never schedule time to grow back.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Giving is your gift. Refilling is your homework.

winter.intro: A winter garden. Frozen on top, busy underneath. You worry productively: lists, backups, a mental spreadsheet of who needs what. You keep it together for everyone, and you'd never admit you're scared too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You overthink in organised folders. Colour-coded.

earth.intro: Soil born in soil weeks. Double Earth. You're the steady one, the reliable one, the one who remembers birthdays. You can also absorb other people's moods like a sponge and call it "being supportive".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Their mood, your weekend. Every time.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Took better care of me than I deserved. Then kept score."

Your coworker: "Saved every project. Also reorganised the shared drive without asking."

Your best friend: "Best friend alive. Worries about me more than I worry about me."

Yeon: All three love you. All three want you to sit down for once.

open.title: You said "it's no trouble". It was trouble.
open.text:
You're the garden field. Nurturing, practical, the one who remembers allergies and birthdays. Everyone's life runs smoother with you in it.

Bom: That's a gift.

Yeon: That's also a mild control issue disguised as kindness.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: the first impression. People think "so sweet". Wait till they see the spreadsheet.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Field: you help people so they | owe you. Not on purpose. But you keep the receipt somewhere in your head.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: "I don't need anything." You need a lot. You just outsourced it to worrying.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: direct, a little intimidating, zero small talk. People sit up straighter.

Yeon: Some of them think you're angry. You're not angry. That's just your face doing listening.

Bom: People trust you instantly. You feel honest.

Yeon: You feel honest because you are. Painfully. Unsolicited. On a Tuesday.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Gyeong. You give blunt advice nobody asked for and call it love.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're fiercely loyal. Anyone in your corner is lucky.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You don't argue. You correct. There's a difference, and everyone you've dated has noticed it.

spring.intro: A blade born in spring, surrounded by things to cut. You see what needs doing and you do it, preferably before anyone has finished explaining. Efficient. Also sometimes the reason the meeting went badly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You solved their problem. They wanted a hug. Classic.

summer.intro: A sword forged in summer. Heat everywhere, so you were shaped by pressure: deadlines, expectations, people who pushed. It made you strong and principled. It also made you assume love is a test you can fail.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to pass anything. You're already loved.

autumn.intro: A sword born in autumn, metal's own season. Double steel. Loyal to the bone, blunt as a brick, and fair in a way that scares people. You'd fight anyone for a friend, and tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the way home.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd take a bullet for a friend. Then critique their aim.

winter.intro: A blade in winter. Cold, clear, and sharpened by thinking. You say less than other Swords, but when you speak it lands like a verdict. People quote you back to yourself years later.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your words stay with people. Choose the kind ones too.

earth.intro: A sword still in the stone. Born in the soil weeks, so you were held, fed and protected before you were ever swung. That gives you patience most Swords lack, and a stubborn streak made of actual rock.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Patient, until you're not. Then it's a sword.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Would've died for me. Wouldn't say sorry, though."

Your coworker: "Fixes everything. Says the quiet part out loud. In the meeting."

Your best friend: "Would bury a body for me. Would also critique how I dug."

Yeon: All three love you. All three want the honesty with ten percent more padding.

open.title: "I'm just being honest" is your catchphrase. And your alibi.
open.text:
You're the sword. Direct, loyal, fair to the point of scary. You'd fight anyone for a friend, then tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the drive home.

Bom: You're so protective.

Yeon: You're protective the way a bodyguard with opinions is protective.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: what people clock in ten seconds. It's the jaw. It's always the jaw.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Sword: you'd rather be right than | close. You'll win the argument and lose the evening, and call it a fair trade.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: that other people's opinions don't touch you. They do. You just get angry instead of hurt.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: put together, precise, a little cool. People wonder if they're being judged.

Yeon: They are. Gently. Also you're judging yourself twice as hard, so it evens out.

Bom: You look effortless. That takes effort.

Yeon: Show one mess. One. People trust a jewel with a scratch more than a display case.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Sin. You noticed the font on the menu was wrong. You said nothing. You'll think about it all week.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You have taste. Real taste. People trust your eye.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You can spot a typo from across the room. And a fake laugh from further.

spring.intro: A jewel born in spring. Everything was growing and you noticed all of it: what's pretty, what's off, what's three millimetres crooked. You have taste. You also have opinions about other people's taste.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You judged the font on their birthday card. Silently.

summer.intro: A jewel in summer heat. Pressure shaped you: to look good, do well, never be the embarrassing one. You're polished and impressive. One careless comment can still ruin your whole week.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unfinished. It's charming, honestly.

autumn.intro: A jewel born in metal's own season. Double shine. High standards, sharp eye, zero patience for sloppy. You're the friend people dress up for. You're also the friend people are slightly scared to disappoint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're a five-star review. With a long comment section.

winter.intro: A jewel in winter water, washed clear. Your mind is quick and your words are precise. You can say one sentence that fixes everything, or one that ends everything. Most of the time you know which.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You see people so clearly. Use it to be kind.

earth.intro: A jewel still in the earth. Born in the soil weeks, so you were protected, maybe a little over-protected. You need to feel safe before you sparkle, and that's not a flaw. It's quality control.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need three green flags before one selfie.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Perfect on paper. Terrified of looking stupid."

Your coworker: "Best work on the team. Rewrote one email eleven times."

Your best friend: "Has never left the house without a backup outfit. Has never once believed a compliment."

Yeon: Three people, one note: relax. You're already the best-dressed person in the room.

open.title: One careless comment ruins your week. One compliment? Suspicious.
open.text:
You're the jewel. Refined, sharp-eyed, impossible to impress cheaply. Your standards are high and mostly aimed at yourself.

Bom: You make everything around you better.

Yeon: You make everything around you better and then quietly mark it out of ten.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: the first impression. People think "polished". You think "they saw the chip in my nail".

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Jewel: you test people with small | cold moments, to see who notices. Most people just think you're cold.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: "I just have high standards." You have high standards and a very low tolerance for being seen trying.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: curious, big ideas, already three topics deep. People feel the pull.

Yeon: Then they try to pin down a date with you and the pull becomes a riptide.

Bom: You make people feel interesting. That's a gift.

Yeon: You make people feel interesting, then disappear for nine days. Also a gift. For them, eventually.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Im. You've had four life plans this year. It's October.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You make life feel bigger. People feel possible around you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You've started four hobbies this month. The guitar is still in the box.

spring.intro: The ocean in spring, pouring itself into everything that grows. You're full of ideas and you give them away: plans, pep talks, 3am theories. People feel bigger around you. You sometimes feel emptier after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You make people feel possible. Keep a little for you.

summer.intro: The ocean in summer, chasing everything. Big appetite for life: trips, people, projects, the next thing. You're magnetic and hard to pin down. Being pinned down is honestly your nightmare.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You said "let's see where it goes". You meant "don't make me commit".

autumn.intro: The ocean in autumn, fed by every stream. Deep, informed, a little too clever. You absorb everything and you can talk your way out of anything. That includes your own feelings.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You intellectualise heartbreak. With footnotes.

winter.intro: The ocean in winter. Double water. Deep, cold on top, enormous underneath. You need a lot of freedom and you think in huge loops. People call you mysterious. You just haven't decided yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your depth scares shallow people. That's their problem.

earth.intro: An ocean held by cliffs. Born in the soil weeks, so you grew up with banks and rules around you. It gave you focus. It also left you with a quiet itch to flood something just to prove you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You follow every rule. Until one random Tuesday.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Best conversations of my life. Never knew if they'd show up."

Your coworker: "Brilliant ideas. Zero follow-up on most of them."

Your best friend: "Can talk about anything. Avoids talking about their feelings by talking about everything else."

Yeon: All three love you. All three would accept one plan you don't cancel.

open.title: "Let's play it by ear." Your whole personality. Everyone's mild nightmare.
open.text:
You're the ocean. Deep, restless, full of ideas and theories and new tabs. You can talk to anyone about anything for hours.

Bom: You're fascinating.

Yeon: You're fascinating and nobody, including you, knows what you're doing on Saturday.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: the first impression. Magnetic. Interesting. Slightly hard to pin down. Like a cat with a podcast.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Ocean: when it gets real, you get | philosophical. You'll explain your feelings brilliantly so you never have to feel them.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: "I just need freedom." Sometimes you need freedom. Sometimes you need to stop running.

base.first-impression:
First ten seconds: soft, quiet, watching. People sense something interesting and can't name it.

Yeon: Also, you leave parties without saying goodbye. Every time. It's a brand now.

Bom: You make people feel calm. It's like being near water.

Yeon: Calm, and slightly unsure if you liked them. You did. Tell them.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Gye. You know everyone's secrets. Nobody knows your middle name.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You sense what people need before they do. That's a quiet superpower.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You can tell who's lying in a group chat from the punctuation alone.

spring.intro: Spring rain. You feed everything around you without anyone noticing it was you. You sense moods, fix vibes, water other people's plants. Quietly essential. Quietly forgotten. Not anymore.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Everything grows a little when you're around.

summer.intro: Rain in summer, gone the moment it lands. You chase what you want in quiet, clever ways, and you vanish when a room gets too loud. People find you fascinating. They also never quite know where you went.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You left the party without saying bye. Again. Iconic.

autumn.intro: Autumn rain, fed by cool clean air. Intuitive to the point of spooky. You know who's lying, who's sad, and who's about to text before your phone even lights up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your gut is right more often than your decisions are.

winter.intro: Winter rain. Double water. Still, deep, mostly internal. You feel everything at full volume and show about four percent of it. Your notes app has more emotional range than most novels.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your quiet isn't empty. It's full.

earth.intro: Rain falling on hard ground. Born in the soil weeks, so you met walls early: rules, expectations, people who didn't get you. You learned to soak in slowly instead of crashing through. Patient. Persistent. Underrated.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't fight walls. You just wear them down. Over years.

three-people.heading: What three people would say about you, if they were brave enough
three-people.text:
Your ex: "Knew exactly how I felt. Never once told me how they felt."

Your coworker: "Quiet. Then says one sentence that changes everything."

Your best friend: "Feels everything. Says 'I'm good' with a face that is not good."

Yeon: All three love you. All three would like the four percent you show bumped to forty.

open.title: Your notes app is a novel. Your texts say "haha ok".
open.text:
You're the rain. Quiet, intuitive, a little mysterious. You read people like you've seen the script.

Bom: People feel understood around you.

Yeon: People feel understood. You feel unknown. And you set it up that way.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: the first impression. "Quiet." "Deep." "Wait, did they leave?"

cliff.text: Yeon: Your red flag, Rain: you disappear instead of saying | you're upset. People don't know they hurt you. They just know you're gone.

sample.text: Your favourite fib: "I'm just private." You're not private. You're hiding with good manners.
